page_title: AST 2-2 LIV | Aston Villa v Liverpool 19/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' The attendance for today's match is 41910.
90+6' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
90+4' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.
90+3' Jacob Ramsey picks out Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
90+2' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Conor Bradley cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' A corner kick by Liverpool is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
86' John McGinn comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa).
84' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
83' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
83' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Aston Villa due to an offside in the build-up play.
81' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) has a goal ruled out for offside!
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Luis Diaz (Liverpool) coming on for Alexis Mac Allister.
80' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
79' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
79' John McGinn (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
78' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Digne is given a rest as he is replaced by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
77' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
77' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
75' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
75' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) dribbles into the box, but Emiliano Martinez is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
74' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
73' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

72' Liverpool slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

71' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

69' Emiliano Martinez doesn't have to worry about this one. Dominik Szoboszlai plays a pass into the feet of Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
67' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Marcus Rashford and he is replaced by Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa).
67' The substitution is prepared. Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marco Asensio.
67' Substitution. Andres Garcia is replaced by Matty Cash (Aston Villa).
66' Substitution. Diogo Jota did his best and is replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
66' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Conor Bradley (Liverpool) replaces Trent Alexander-Arnold.
64' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a long ball forward to Diogo Jota, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
64' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
63' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends the corner into the box, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts it and averts the threat.

63' The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
61' 2 - 2 Goal! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is teed up on the edge of the box by Mohamed Salah, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 2:2.
60' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the crossbar.
59' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Aston Villa.

57' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Emiliano Martinez has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

56' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
55' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.
55' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
53' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) attempts to find Ollie Watkins, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
51' Craig Pawson blows his whistle. John McGinn (Aston Villa) commits a foul after dangerous play.
51' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alisson is well positioned and punches the ball away.

50' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
49' The linesman signals a throw-in for Aston Villa.
48' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.

47' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will take a throw-in.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' 2 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Lucas Digne and easily beat the keeper with a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 2:1.
45+2' 53:47 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' Liverpool are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
44' It's a throw-in for Aston Villa.
43' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Diogo Jota (Liverpool), but the defence gets it clear.
42' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) swings it in and Marcus Rashford gets on the end of it, but Alisson shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
40' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the left post.

40' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.
37' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) steps up to take an indirect free kick. Will he decide to restart play with a short or long pass?
36' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Craig Pawson no option but to blow his whistle.
33' Andres Garcia (Aston Villa) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
30' A pass by Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
29' 0 - 1 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Diogo Jota, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
27' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

26' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is first to react to a lofted pass from Andrew Robertson, but fires his header miles over the bar from near the penalty spot. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
25' Good defending. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) tries to find Dominik Szoboszlai inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
23' Axel Disasi (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card.
23' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Andres Garcia (Aston Villa). The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
21' Andres Garcia (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

20' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Emiliano Martinez makes a great save to stop his effort.
19' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
17' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
14' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) takes it short.
14' Axel Disasi (Aston Villa) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
13' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.

13' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Aston Villa.
11' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
9' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
9' The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a throw-in.
8' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Craig Pawson who sees an offensive foul.

6' What a chance that is! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
6' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
5' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
4' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

4' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
4' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes a short corner kick.
2' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is behind the touchline and Liverpool will take a throw-in.
1' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Craig Pawson.
